name: Rayos X Facial
description: Utiliza técnica de rayos X facial para detectar manipulación de video
algorithm: Face X-Ray Boundary — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method implements the Face X-ray technique from Li et al. (2020) for general face forgery detection:

1. **Mezcla Límite Hypothesis**: Face X-ray is based on the key insight that most face manipulation methods share a common step — blending a modified face region onto a background. This blending creates a detectable boundary even when the face modification itself is imperceptible. The method targets this universal blending step rather than specific manipulation artifacts.

2. **Gray - Scale Mezcla Map Estimación**: For each pixel, the method estimates whether it belongs to a blending boundary. The "face X-ray" is computed as a map B(x) indicating the probability that pixel x is at a face blending boundary. This is estimated using the observation that blended regions show HR (high-resolution) content from the face source mixed with LR (low-resolution) content from the background at boundaries.

3. **Multi - Scale Límite Detección**: The face X-ray is computed at multiple scales to detect blending at different resolutions. Blending boundaries may be sharp (simple alpha compositing) or smooth (Poisson blending, feathered masks), requiring multi-scale analysis for robust detection.

4. **Cross - Color - Space Análisis**: The blending boundary signature is analyzed in multiple color spaces (RGB, YCbCr, HSV). Different color channels may show blending artifacts with varying intensity — YCbCr chrominance channels are particularly sensitive to blending artifacts that are invisible in luminance.

5. **Temporal X - ray Consistencia**: The face X-ray map is computed per frame and tracked temporally. A persistent blending boundary at consistent facial locations across frames provides strong evidence of face manipulation. The temporal stability of the X-ray signal increases detection confidence and reduces false positives from compression artifacts or natural skin boundaries.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante face x-ray boundary analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Li, Y. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
